name: deprecated
description: Archive of superseded skills kept installable for old workflows; every skill points at its replacement

interface.shortDescription: Archive of superseded skills; prefer the replacements
interface.longDescription: Superseded skills moved out of their original plugins, kept installable so old workflows keep resolving. Each skill carries a deprecation banner naming its replacement in the presentations plugin, the workbench plugin (pilot, subagent-driven-development), or the writing plugin (ghostwrite, coach); terse-mode retires without replacement. Do not install alongside presentations, workbench, or writing unless you need the old skill names.
